slides.title: Russia–Africa summit: Ethiopia weighs the gains
slides.body: Ahead of the Moscow summit on Oct 28–29, a forum in Addis Ababa asked what Ethiopia would actually gain.
Ethiopia–Russia trade in the first half of 2025, more than double a year earlier, according to Russia's ambassador to Ethiopia.

slides.title: A trade imbalance
slides.body: Ethiopia's exports to Russia are modest, mainly coffee, flowers, oilseeds and pulses. Speakers called market access a core challenge.

slides.title: Results, not goodwill
slides.body: Participants at the forum, hosted by the University for Peace, said the summit should be judged on measurable, binding commitments: trade, infrastructure, technology.

slides.title: Open, accountable diplomacy.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
